qualification_reason: Full working-tree src/main/java changed by newly added, unregistered/uncompiled RcWakeGameTests during mixed. Existing FE runner checks actual launch classes/resources, not complete checkout source. As-run raw passed fields remain untouched. This candidate is not final acceptance.
source_vs_binary: Added source file archived; only that Java addition found, no existing Java file post-run hash changed. Tested56c14 JAR remained unchanged and no RcWake.class exists in it or the frozen launch classes. Original runtime byte guards stayed true. Source audit is separate from runtime artifact identity, not evidence of a binary change.
scope_notes: n1 per layout/40 low-flow probes; no significance or population-tail claim.

Fixed counters stop before final drain. Full cost ends after real drain plus2.2s zero-asset quiet guard/final counters; not all future maintenance/history retention. SQL/WAL/local mirrors are not additive assets.
Actual fixed inputs and true external outputs compared; no equality assumed merely from attempts. Main inputs are native FE capability events, not chests/world saves.

Whole-MC/Runtime histograms cover all completed instrumented calls in explicit fixed-prefix/full windows, not avg100/rings/targetTPS. Sparse p50/95/99 values are bin upper bounds. Durations are wall time, not CPU timers.
Each JVM clock is independent; no cross-JVM nanoTime subtraction. ActualTPS is achieved tick-start rate. Frame-depth overflow count UNMEASURED; depth mismatches/trace errors separately retained.
Per-reason sparse absent supported keys are zero; f3 lacks reason counters=UNMEASURED. Multiple reasons may label one request; effective is not delivered input count.
FE probe records method invocations, not per-batch endpoint membership. No exact source/receiver batch interleaving is inferred from aggregate counts.

Known source addition happened in mixed; earlier two windows had the pre-existing source tree by operator statement/post-run hash evidence, not continuous source-write tracing. All three used the same frozen fab runtime bytes.
